Jury seats open only to identities older than 44 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 44 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time someone pays for every seat it wants. A 437 account operation therefore ties up 31 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
